name: Inyoni
personality: Dedicated archer who has trained since childhood and recently made a name for herself.
story: Inyoni of Bragança is known as the 'Magical Bow' for her archery. She appears in Dagsion around 10/7 and joins for gold: 3000G on Leda's route (the cheapest), 4000G on Theodora's and 6000G on Cai's or Dietrich's. Her signature weapon is Ugo's Bow.

personalSkill.name: Heavy-Bow User
personalSkill.effect: Str+3 when equipped with a bow. Lv20: Pierce (Atk+2, Crit+5); Lv35: Pierce+ (Atk+4, Crit+10).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A tier. KeenGamer: C tier (late arrival; most affordable on Leda's route).

why: Renown 7 here is the earliest join: Ch 9 week 1, once she appears (about 7/10).
recruit.tip: Cheapest fee in the game: 3,000G, versus 6,000G on Cai's or Dietrich's route.

build.notes: Recruit her in Ch 9 week 1: about Lv 15 in a Beginner class with a War Bow (one test). Hunter to Lv 20 in Ch 9's dungeons, Archer for her first map in Ch 10, Sniper at Lv 35. Da Mina Bow arts every turn for Pierce; Leda's third Dance target.

guide.summary: The army's only archer from Ch 10 and its flier killer: Heavy-Bow User (Str +3) and [[ability:Pierce]] make every bow art hit hard. She joins in Ch 9 week 1 at about Lv 15 and levels in Ch 9's dungeons; from Ch 10 stand two tiles behind the tanks, open each turn with an art, and take Leda's third dance after Sirocco and Guzran.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: an art from range 2, then Leda's dance for a second shot. Enemy phase: the [[item:Mini Bow]] equipped so she counters at range 1.
keys: Recruit her in Ch 9 week 1 (from about 7/10): Renown 7, 3,000G
Hunter to Lv 20 in Ch 9's dungeons, then [[class:Archer]] before the Ch 10 map (Bow C)
Fire a bow art every turn: Pierce adds Atk and Crit to arts only
Give her Leda's [[item:Archer's Ring]] and [[item:Mini Bow]]; the [[item:Da Mina Bow]] +2 is her main bow
Dance her after kills in Ch 10 to 12: [[class:Sniper]] at Lv 35 with Bow B
watch: Weight: Da Mina Bow +3 6 + Gale Ring 2 = 8; Mini Bow 5 + 2 = 7. Longbow 13 only on Deadeye turns
Spd: growth 45 in Archer and Sniper; fast swordfighters double her
Range 1: no counter without the Mini Bow; equip it before ending the turn
Levels: Lv 15 on join; Ch 9 dungeons must reach Lv 20 before the Ch 10 map

guide.alt: Ch 9 dungeon and Arena seats full? A 9/28 join brings about Lv 25 with an Iron Bow and a Tempest Bow (one test), but grown on personal growths only.

routeNotes.note: Dadao is her only partner here, and he's on the bench from Ch 9. Meal seat from her Ch 9 join: Leda + Dadao + Inyoni.
Third Dance target after Sirocco and Guzran. A ranged unit is the safest one to dance: she never ends in melee range.
Song of Passion+ (Str +7) feeds her Str-based arts. Song of Abjuring is her Part III undead answer.

decisions.why: Every level from Lv 15 grows Hunter and Archer rows, and Ch 9's seven weeks of dungeons and Arena land Lv 20 and Bow C before her first map. Unrecruited units auto-level on personal growths only.

decisions.pick: Da Mina Bow +2 main, Wooden Bow +5 as fallback
decisions.why: She fires an art every turn for Pierce. Da Mina gets Hit 80 on arts and +2 adds Mt (Sword +2 is Mt 20). Wooden Bow +5 (Wt 4) is the swap when Spd misses the double.
